newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa sees leaner Spain electric sector results.
newsitem.headline: Endesa sees leaner Spain electric sector results.

text.p: Endesa Chief Executive Rafael Miranda said on Tuesday that Spanish electricity results will be leaner under the new regime governing the sector.

"Results will have to be leaner with the new environment, although Endesa has been capable of using cost reductions to offset the fall in the tariff and the growth of self-suppliers," Miranda told reporters ahead of Wednesday's shareholders' meeting.

He said December's electricity protocol -- a broad agreement to implement measures opening the sector to full competition-- affected utilities, although he highlighted that Endesa had achieved a four percent rise in profits in the first quarter year-on-year, without taking into account a revaluation of fixed assets.
Miranda highlighted Endesa's diversification with presence in water, gas, renewable energies and telecommunications sectors.
Chairman Rodolfo Martin Villa also reiterated his call for equal treatment from gas supplier Gas Natural as other utilities receive.
Shareholders tomorrow are expected to approve a total dividend of 280 pesetas per share against 1996 results, up 50.5 percent from the year earlier.
